items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So, he, he came to my band.

ctx.x: Same building, on the sixth floor of the Dracula castle. So, I met this guy and he told me, you have to meet Claudio Roditi; he’s a great trumpet player from Brazil and on those days, I understand that Claudio was planning to go back to Brazil because he didn’t have enough gigs here. So, I mention to Diego Romero that I was looking for an extra horn in the group, and I mention that, “You have to listen to Claudio Roditi; I mean he’s fantastic” He mix Brazilian music with Jazz very well, and I was in love with…
was a vehicle to help me in the front line, and also to learn more about the Brazilian music. So, he, he came to my band.
You expanded the band to a quintet?
